steps.name: Open closed-for-season op
steps.do: Select **Set exhibit as closed for the season**.
steps.expect: Closed for the season form opens with **Exhibit**, **Start date**, **Last day** and **Closure message**.

steps.name: Submit with blank message
steps.do: Select **Kids Zoo**. Leave **Start date**, **Last day** and **Closure message** blank. Click **Save**.
steps.expect: Success that **Kids Zoo** was set as closed for the season.

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. Leave **Include off display animals** unchecked.
steps.expect: **Kids Zoo** animal markers such as **Guinea Pig** and **Rabbit** are absent. The **Kids Zoo** closed-exhibit overlay looks the same as for any other closed exhibit.

steps.name: Winter-blue markers
steps.expect: Every **Kids Zoo** animal marker appears with a light winter-blue background. Click **Guinea Pig**: the popup is blue with a snowflake and reads **The Kids Zoo is closed for the season.**

steps.name: Regular closure keeps likelihood colour
steps.do: In Console, use **Set exhibit as closed** for **Americas Pavilion** with blank dates, then return to the map with **Include off display animals** enabled.
steps.expect: **Americas Pavilion** animals use their usual likelihood colour, not winter blue. Only animals in season-closed exhibits are winter blue.

steps.name: Open-for-season lists season only
steps.do: In Console, open **Set exhibit as open for the season** and expand **Exhibit**.
steps.expect: **Kids Zoo** is listed. **Americas Pavilion** is not listed because it is not closed for the season.

steps.name: Submit open for season
steps.do: Select **Kids Zoo**, leave the dates blank and click **Save**.
steps.expect: Success that **Kids Zoo** was set as open for the season.

steps.name: Regular open cleanup
steps.do: Open **Set exhibit as open**. Select **Americas Pavilion** and click **Save**.
steps.expect: Success that **Americas Pavilion** was set as explicitly open.

steps.name: Map restored
steps.do: From the bottom nav, return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Include off display animals** unchecked.
steps.expect: **Kids Zoo** and **Americas Pavilion** animals show as normal on-display markers again, with no closed-exhibit overlay on either exhibit.
